title: Council appoints new Ward 10 councillor
subtitle: Short special meeting gave final approval to the appointment by-law and confirmed the meeting's proceedings.
overview: Kitchener City Council held a brief special meeting on January 22, 2024. It was chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic and ran from 12:32 p.m. to 12:36 p.m. No pecuniary interests were declared, and the mayor had no updates.

The only substantive business was a by-law to appoint Stephanie Stretch as the member of council for Ward 10. Council gave the by-law third reading on a recorded vote, and the minutes record that it carried unanimously. A second by-law confirmed the actions of the meeting.

For residents of Ward 10, the appointment means the ward again has a councillor to represent it at the council table and to take up local concerns. No transcript of the meeting was available, so this summary relies on the official minutes. The minutes do not record any debate or the reasons behind the appointment.

decisions.detail: Council gave third reading to By-law 2024-006, appointing Stephanie Stretch as the member of council representing Ward 10, on a recorded vote that carried unanimously.
